user.title: HeatFlow: set up controller
user.description: ON below target, OFF above target + hysteresis. Set target and hysteresis on the card afterwards.

data_description.sensor_timeout: No sensor value for this many minutes -> switch OFF. 0 = disabled.

leistung.title: HeatFlow: power measurement (optional)
leistung.description: The selected plugs provide power readings. Keep them so HeatFlow shows the consumption, or clear the field.

data_description.leistung_sensoren: Optional. Sensors in W/kW, summed up. Display only, no effect on control.
data_description.leistung_auto: If nothing is selected above, the power sensors of the plug devices are used automatically.
